# Share Screen With Customer — No Install

Walking a customer through a fix over the phone is frustrating. Share a link, troubleshoot together with screen share and chat, then let the room disappear. Free.

Create a Room Free · No account · No download

## The Problem

Walking a customer through a fix over the phone is frustrating. 'Click the menu in the top-left... no, the other top-left.' Screen share solves this, but most tools need downloads.

## How JoinByKey Solves It

JoinByKey screen share works peer-to-peer in the browser. The agent sends a room link, the customer opens it, and either side can share their screen instantly. No extension, no app, no admin rights.

## Where Support Teams Use It

Software onboarding, printer setup, form completion, configuration guidance, security-setting walkthroughs.

## Privacy & Disposable by Design

JoinByKey rooms are disposable. The support chat, screen share session, and feedback live only as long as the room. After expiry everything is permanently deleted — no customer record persists, no ticket history, no per-seat fee.
